content.text: The docs split creation by source. I'll pull the exact Modal and Daytona create paths so each example matches a real provider option.

The official guides split sandbox creation by source. Kit only has runnable examples for two of those paths, and several documented sources have no mapping at all.

## Daytona

The [sandboxes guide](https://www.daytona.io/docs/en/sandboxes/) and the [Go `Create` method](https://www.daytona.io/docs/en/go-sdk/daytona/) use two SDK arguments: `types.SnapshotParams` and `types.ImageParams`. A nil argument is the default snapshot.

| Documented create | Native call | Kit today |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Default snapshot | `Create(ctx, nil)` | Example: `create-daytona-sandbox` |
| Named snapshot | `SnapshotParams{Snapshot: "daytona-small"}` and the other stock snapshots (`daytona-medium`, `daytona-large`, `daytona-gpu`, `daytona-vm-*`, `windows-*`) | Mapped when `SnapshotKind` is default. No example |
| Public image | `ImageParams{Image: "ubuntu:22.04"}`. Tag or digest required; `latest`, `lts`, and `stable` are rejected | Mapped. No example. Resource overrides belong on this path only |
| Linux VM / Windows | Create a class-specific snapshot, then `SnapshotParams` | Sandbox create from a snapshot name is mapped. Creating the snapshot, and choosing container / Linux VM / Windows / GPU class, is not |
| GPU and spot GPU | Image plus `Resources.GPU` and `GpuType` | Not mapped. Docs already call GPU a future creation setting |
| Ephemeral | `Ephemeral: true` or auto-delete `0` | `Lifetime.Ephemeral` is mapped. No example |
| Linked child | `LinkedSandbox` plus ephemeral | Mapped. No example |
| macOS | use.computer API, not the Daytona Go SDK | Out of scope |

Stock snapshots carry their own CPU, memory, disk, and class. Image creation defaults to 1 vCPU, 1 GiB memory, and 3 GiB disk, with documented standard-tier caps of 4 vCPU, 8 GiB, and 10 GiB. Custom resources are an image-create option, not a snapshot-create option.

## Modal

[Sandbox.Create](https://modal.com/docs/sdk/go/latest/Sandbox) always takes an existing app and an `Image`. There is no default-source create. Image construction is a separate step.

| Documented create | Native call | Kit today |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Registry image | `Images.FromRegistry` then `Sandboxes.Create` | Example: `create-modal-sandbox`. Resources example covers CPU, memory, and lifetime |
| Private registry | `FromRegistry` with a `Secret`, `FromAwsEcr`, `FromGcpArtifactRegistry` | `ImageSource` is only a reference string. No secret-backed or cloud-registry lookup |
| Existing image | `Images.FromID`, `Images.FromName` | Not mapped. Kit always calls `FromRegistry` |
| Filesystem snapshot | `SnapshotFilesystem` returns an `Image`, then `Create` | Rejected. Default, snapshot, and warm-pool sources are unsupported |
| Memory snapshot restore | `ExperimentalFromSnapshot` | Not mapped |
| V2 sandbox | `ExperimentalCreate` | Not mapped |
| Image build | `DockerfileCommands` / `Build` | Not a sandbox create |

Mapped Modal options that still have no dedicated example: entrypoint, working directory, and PTY; gVisor versus Linux VM; cloud and region; environment and tags; secrets and workload identity; egress, ports, and private network; idle termination; readiness wait; verbose logging.

## What the examples do not cover yet

Already present: Modal registry image, Modal resources, Daytona default snapshot, Daytona idle-pause and delayed-delete.

Mapped, but no project: Daytona named snapshot, Daytona image (with resources), Daytona ephemeral, Daytona linked sandbox, and the Modal option groups above.

Documented, but Kit cannot create them: Modal image-by-id/name, private and cloud registries, filesystem and memory snapshots, experimental V2; Daytona snapshot class, GPU, spot GPU, and macOS.

# Create a Daytona sandbox from a snapshot

Create one sandbox from the stock `daytona-small` snapshot and print its ID.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer and this checkout.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-daytona-from-snapshot
cp .env.example .env
# Set DAYTONA_API_KEY, then:
go run .
```

`daytona-small` is a 1 vCPU container snapshot. Other stock names, such as
`daytona-medium` and `daytona-vm-small`, use the same `Snapshot` field.
Closing the client does not delete the sandbox.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create a Daytona sandbox from an image

Create one sandbox from `ubuntu:22.04` with 1 vCPU, 1 GiB memory, and 3 GiB disk.

Resource overrides require an image. CPU must be a whole number of cores.
Memory and disk must be whole GiB, expressed as MiB.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer and this checkout.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-daytona-from-image
cp .env.example .env
# Set DAYTONA_API_KEY, then:
go run .
```

The image needs a tag or digest. Daytona rejects `latest`, `lts`, and `stable`.
Closing the client does not delete the sandbox.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create an ephemeral Daytona sandbox

Create one sandbox from the default snapshot and mark it ephemeral. Daytona
deletes an ephemeral sandbox when it stops.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer and this checkout.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-daytona-ephemeral
cp .env.example .env
# Set DAYTONA_API_KEY, then:
go run .
```

Closing the client does not stop the sandbox. Stopping it deletes it.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create a linked Daytona sandbox

Create a parent sandbox from the default snapshot, then an ephemeral child
linked to that parent. Daytona schedules the child on the same runner.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer and this checkout.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-daytona-linked
cp .env.example .env
# Set DAYTONA_API_KEY, then:
go run .
```

The program creates two sandboxes. The child is ephemeral. Closing the client
does not stop either sandbox.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create a Modal sandbox with a runtime

Create one sandbox from `alpine:3.21`, set the working directory to `/tmp`,
run `echo sandbox-kit`, and enable a PTY.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer, this checkout, and an existing Modal app.
See [Modal creation](../create-modal-sandbox/README.md) for the token and app.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-modal-with-runtime
cp .env.example .env
go run .
```

Closing the client does not terminate the sandbox.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create a Modal gVisor sandbox

Create one sandbox from `alpine:3.21` on Modal's gVisor container runtime.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer, this checkout, and an existing Modal app.
See [Modal creation](../create-modal-sandbox/README.md) for the token and app.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-modal-gvisor
cp .env.example .env
go run .
```

Closing the client does not terminate the sandbox.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create a Modal Linux VM sandbox

Create one sandbox from `alpine:3.21` on Modal's Linux VM runtime.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer, this checkout, and an existing Modal app.
See [Modal creation](../create-modal-sandbox/README.md) for the token and app.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-modal-linux-vm
cp .env.example .env
go run .
```

Closing the client does not terminate the sandbox.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create a Modal sandbox with placement

Create one sandbox from `alpine:3.21` with a cloud preference. `MODAL_CLOUD`
defaults to `auto`. Set `MODAL_REGION` to add a region preference.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer, this checkout, and an existing Modal app.
See [Modal creation](../create-modal-sandbox/README.md) for the token and app.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-modal-with-placement
cp .env.example .env
go run .
```

A preference is not a scheduling guarantee. Closing the client does not
terminate the sandbox.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create a Modal sandbox with environment and tags

Create one sandbox from `alpine:3.21` with `SANDBOX_KIT=example` and the tag
`example=labels`.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer, this checkout, and an existing Modal app.
See [Modal creation](../create-modal-sandbox/README.md) for the token and app.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-modal-with-labels
cp .env.example .env
go run .
```

Closing the client does not terminate the sandbox.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create a Modal sandbox with outbound access blocked

Create one sandbox from `alpine:3.21` and block all outbound network access.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer, this checkout, and an existing Modal app.
See [Modal creation](../create-modal-sandbox/README.md) for the token and app.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-modal-with-network
cp .env.example .env
go run .
```

Closing the client does not terminate the sandbox.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create a Modal sandbox with an idle timeout

Create one sandbox from `alpine:3.21` that terminates after 60 idle seconds.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer, this checkout, and an existing Modal app.
See [Modal creation](../create-modal-sandbox/README.md) for the token and app.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-modal-idle
cp .env.example .env
go run .
```

Closing the client does not terminate the sandbox. The idle policy does, once
the sandbox has been idle for 60 seconds.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create a Modal sandbox and wait until ready

Create one sandbox from `alpine:3.21`, start `sleep 300`, and wait until the
command `true` succeeds. The wait uses a two-minute creation timeout.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer, this checkout, and an existing Modal app.
See [Modal creation](../create-modal-sandbox/README.md) for the token and app.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-modal-ready
cp .env.example .env
go run .
```

Closing the client does not terminate the sandbox.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create a Modal sandbox with verbose logging

Create one sandbox from `alpine:3.21` with Modal verbose logging enabled.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer, this checkout, and an existing Modal app.
See [Modal creation](../create-modal-sandbox/README.md) for the token and app.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-modal-verbose
cp .env.example .env
go run .
```

Closing the client does not terminate the sandbox.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

# Create a Modal sandbox with a workload identity

Create one sandbox from `alpine:3.21` and request a Modal identity token for
the workload.

## Run

Requires Go 1.26.1 or newer, this checkout, and an existing Modal app.
See [Modal creation](../create-modal-sandbox/README.md) for the token and app.

```sh
cd examples/go/create-modal-with-identity
cp .env.example .env
go run .
```

Closing the client does not terminate the sandbox.

```sh
GOWORK=off go test ./...
```

input.description: Format and compile new example modules
Show files changed by the examples

content.text:
Each supported create path now has its own small project under `examples/go/`. Each one loads `.env`, creates the sandbox, prints the ID, and exits. The existing error-handling projects are unchanged.

**Daytona**

| Project | Creates |
| --- | --- |
| `create-daytona-from-snapshot` | Stock `daytona-small` snapshot |
| `create-daytona-from-image` | `ubuntu:22.04` with 1 vCPU, 1 GiB memory, 3 GiB disk |
| `create-daytona-ephemeral` | Default snapshot, deleted when it stops |
| `create-daytona-linked` | A parent, then an ephemeral child on the same runner |

**Modal** (all from `alpine:3.21`, using the same app and token as the existing Modal example)

| Project | Creates |
| --- | --- |
| `create-modal-with-runtime` | `/tmp`, entrypoint `echo sandbox-kit`, PTY on |
| `create-modal-gvisor` | gVisor container |
| `create-modal-linux-vm` | Linux VM |
| `create-modal-with-placement` | Cloud `auto`, optional `MODAL_REGION` |
| `create-modal-with-labels` | One environment variable and one tag |
| `create-modal-with-network` | Outbound access blocked |
| `create-modal-idle` | Terminates after 60 idle seconds |
| `create-modal-ready` | Waits until the command `true` succeeds |
| `create-modal-verbose` | Verbose provider logging |
| `create-modal-with-identity` | Workload identity token |

Copy `.env.example` to `.env` in the project you want, then run `go run .`. These programs create real sandboxes. `create-daytona-linked` creates two.

They all compile. `sandbox-kit test go` includes them. There is still no example for a Modal secret injection, because that needs a secret that already exists in the workspace. Image-by-id, private registries, filesystem and memory snapshots, experimental V2, GPU, and macOS remain unmapped.

input.command:
set -e
cd /Users/nabhag/OpenSource/kit
mkdir -p examples/go/modal examples/go/daytona
for d in create-modal-sandbox create-modal-with-resources create-modal-with-runtime create-modal-gvisor create-modal-linux-vm create-modal-with-placement create-modal-with-labels create-modal-with-network create-modal-idle create-modal-ready create-modal-verbose create-modal-with-identity handle-modal-errors; do
  mv "examples/go/$d" "examples/go/modal/$d"
done
for d in create-daytona-sandbox create-daytona-from-snapshot create-daytona-from-image create-daytona-ephemeral create-daytona-linked create-daytona-with-policies handle-daytona-errors; do
  mv "examples/go/$d" "examples/go/daytona/$d"
done
# Module path and replace depth: one extra directory.
find examples/go/modal examples/go/daytona -name go.mod -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  perl -i -pe 's#examples/go/(create-|handle-)#examples/go/PLACEHOLDER/$1#; s#PLACEHOLDER/(create-modal|handle-modal)#modal/$1#; s#PLACEHOLDER/(create-daytona|handle-daytona)#daytona/$1#; s#=> \.\./\.\./\.\./sdks#=> ../../../../sdks#' "$f"
done
# Docs links that climbed three levels now need four.
find examples/go/modal examples/go/daytona -name README.md -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  perl -i -pe 's#\]\(\.\./\.\./\.\./#](../../../../#g; s#cd examples/go/(create-modal|handle-modal)#cd examples/go/modal/$1#g; s#cd examples/go/(create-daytona|handle-daytona)#cd examples/go/daytona/$1#g' "$f"
done
echo "moved"
find examples/go/modal examples/go/daytona -name go.mod -exec grep -H '^module \|^replace ' {} \;
